data: Which embedding method(s) show(s) a high attention weight for the word 'amazing'?

The question asks which embedding method(s) show(s) a high attention weight for the word 'amazing'. From the analysis of the figure, we can see that the orange line (MATT-BIE) has a significantly higher attention weight for the word 'amazing' compared to the blue line (ATT-E). The blue line shows a lower attention weight for the same word. Therefore, the MATT-BIE embedding method shows a high attention weight for the word 'amazing'.
